one_liner: Configure Megatron-LM + DeepSpeed parallelism degrees for a multi-hundred-GPU run and measure hardware efficiency via MFU/HFU.

key_terms.definition: NVIDIA's library of parallelism-aware transformer building blocks (column/row-parallel GEMMs, MoE layers, parallel_state topology) importable by other training frameworks.
DeepSpeed's sharding scheme across three stages (optimizer states, +gradients, +parameters) that removes redundant per-GPU copies of training state kept by vanilla DDP.
ZeRO variants that move optimizer states and parameters off the GPU to CPU RAM (Offload) or NVMe storage (Infinity) when host memory exceeds GPU memory.
Fraction of a cluster's peak FLOP/s spent on useful forward+backward model arithmetic, computed as (FLOPs/token x tokens/s) / peak FLOP/s; 35-55% is healthy for dense models.
Fraction of peak FLOP/s spent on all FLOPs actually issued to the GPU, including wasted recomputation from activation checkpointing; always HFU >= MFU.
The pipeline-parallel execution schedule whose idle-time (bubble) fraction is approximately (PP-1)/(PP-1+m), m being the in-flight micro-batch count.
Idle GPU time in pipeline parallelism caused by stage dependencies at the start/end of each step, quantified by the 1F1B bubble-fraction formula and reduced via more micro-batches or interleaving.
Megatron scheme assigning each GPU multiple non-contiguous chunks of layers (v chunks), cutting the pipeline bubble by roughly a factor of v at the cost of more inter-stage messages.
Parallelism dimension that shards Mixture-of-Experts experts across ranks and dispatches token activations between them via all-to-all collectives, forming a fourth axis N = DP x TP x PP x EP.

Megatron technique that shards activations along the sequence dimension outside TP-sharded GEMM blocks, replacing an all-reduce with all-gather + reduce-scatter to cut activation memory by a factor of TP.
